description: This file defines the StyleMerger class, which provides methods to merge CSS-style properties into a base style object, focusing on font, fill, border, and number formatting for spreadsheet cell styling.

classes.name: StyleMerger
classes.description: A class to merge styling attributes into a base style, including font, fill, borders, and number formats for spreadsheet styling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StyleMerger with a base Style object.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the current base Style object.

methods.name: mergeStyle
methods.description: Merges properties from another Style object into the base style.

methods.name: mergeFontStyle
methods.description: Merges font properties from one Font object into another.

methods.name: mergeFillStyle
methods.description: Merges fill properties from one Fill object into another.

methods.name: mergeBordersStyle
methods.description: Merges border properties from one Borders object into another.

methods.name: mergeBorderStyle
methods.description: Merges individual Border properties from one Border object into another.
